description:
Remove content using the AI Remove tool (or generative fill fallback) on the current selection.

Use when: erasing distractions, people, or objects with generative AI.
Do NOT use when: generative unavailable — fallback to photoshop_recipe_remove_distraction.

Returns: { ok, summary, details }.
Preconditions: selection or auto_select_subject; generative_fill capability.
Side effects: inpaints selected region; consumes generative credits when cloud-backed.

auto_select_subject.description: Run Select Subject when no selection exists (default false)

document_id.description: Photoshop document id from photoshop_get_state / photoshop_list_documents. Send null or 0 to use the active document. A positive number activates that document before the tool runs. When no document is open, a stale id does not block the call.

name: photoshop_generative_remove
